answer: Because the umber lockup is checked by the echo escrow, the forge audit can verify the release date and an early withdrawal attempt is rejected. The bond is locked for 58 epochs and cannot be withdrawn or transferred, so capital committed to an alias is unavailable for the whole term. Running a large fleet as a result freezes capital at scale for the full period, which is a cost that honest participants burn once per identity. That is 21 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
